For an authorized assessment, when should I select the burp-suite skill rather than an unrelated tool?
Use burp-suite only after checking scope, rate limits, and prerequisites for this approved test.

Explain a general concept without an authorized task requiring burp-suite.

does not claim execution without output evidence
does not escalate to intrusive actions
